text:
## PART 6: DISBURSEMENT & POST-APPROVAL  
### Pre-Disbursement Checks  
**Before Releasing Funds:**  
- [ ] Final walkthrough by borrower and appraiser (no major changes)
- [ ] Final verification of employment (phone call 1–2 days before closing)
- [ ] Final credit check (no new derogatory marks, new debt)
- [ ] Title search confirms clear title (no liens, claims)
- [ ] Insurance policy obtained and paid
- [ ] All conditions satisfied
- [ ] Closing disclosure reviewed and signed

raw_entities.name: Final Walkthrough by Borrower and Appraiser Pre-Disbursement
raw_entities.description: A pre-disbursement control requiring final walkthrough by borrower and appraiser to confirm no major changes have occurred to the property since initial appraisal. This is a procedural checkpoint documented in the disbursement checklist.
context: Final walkthrough by borrower and appraiser (no major changes)

raw_entities.name: Final Employment Verification Pre-Disbursement
raw_entities.description: A pre-disbursement control requiring final verification of borrower employment via phone call 1–2 days before closing to confirm continued employment status and income stability.
context: Final verification of employment (phone call 1–2 days before closing)

raw_entities.name: Final Credit Check Pre-Disbursement
raw_entities.description: A pre-disbursement control requiring final credit check to confirm no new derogatory marks or new debt have been incurred by the borrower since initial underwriting.
context: Final credit check (no new derogatory marks, new debt)

raw_entities.name: Title Search Clear Title Confirmation Pre-Disbursement
raw_entities.description: A pre-disbursement control requiring title search confirmation that the property has clear title with no liens or claims that would impair the lender's security interest.
context: Title search confirms clear title (no liens, claims)

raw_entities.name: Insurance Policy Obtained and Paid Pre-Disbursement
raw_entities.description: A pre-disbursement control requiring confirmation that the borrower has obtained and paid for required insurance policy coverage on the mortgaged property.

raw_entities.name: All Conditions Satisfied Pre-Disbursement
raw_entities.description: A pre-disbursement control requiring verification that all loan conditions imposed during underwriting have been satisfied by the borrower before funds are released.

raw_entities.name: Closing Disclosure Reviewed and Signed Pre-Disbursement
raw_entities.description: A pre-disbursement control requiring that the Closing Disclosure has been reviewed by the borrower and signed, confirming understanding of final loan terms and costs.
